description: Test suite for the 'Item Price' doctype in ERPNext, including validation, price calculation, and field tests.

classes.name: TestItemPrice
classes.description: Test case class for Item Price doctype, inheriting from ERPNextTestCase.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up test environment, clears existing Item Price records, and creates test records.

methods.name: test_addition_of_new_fields
methods.description: Verifies the presence of new fields in Item Price.

methods.name: test_dates_validation_error
methods.description: Checks validation error for invalid date ranges.

methods.name: test_price_in_a_qty
methods.description: Validates correct price retrieval for a specific quantity.

methods.name: test_price_with_no_qty
methods.description: Checks price retrieval when no quantity is specified.

methods.name: test_prices_at_date
